# Rama Makeover (रमा मेकओव्हर)

> Beauty parlour in Datta Nagar, Dighi, near Datta Mandir, Pimpri-Chinchwad, Maharashtra 411015, India. Offers head lice removal for children and adults, plus facials, hydra facial, threading, waxing, haircut, bridal makeup and festival and occasion makeup.

- Hydra facial

Charges depend on the service; call or WhatsApp 9372448675 for details and appointments.
